summary: RFC 4364 and RFC 4659 describe provider-provisioned Layer 3 VPNs. This document defines procedures so RSVP reservation messages can pass from one customer site to another across such a VPN, allowing admission control on the links between customer and provider edge routers.

eli5.summary: A company's offices share a private network run by a carrier. This lets the offices reserve bandwidth through it end to end, not only inside the carrier's part.

questions: resource reservation across bgp mpls vpn
